# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a single version of Python
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-python

name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "next"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main", "next"]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  checks: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v3
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v4
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv sync
      - name: Run pre-commit
        run: |
          uv run pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage pre-commit
      # - name: Lint with flake8
      #   run: |
      #     # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
      #     flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
      #     # exit-zero treats all errors as warnings. The GitHub editor is 127 chars wide
      #     flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics
      - name: Check environment variables
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}" ]; then
            echo "Error: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set in repository secrets"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.LIVEKIT_API_KEY_SIMULATION }}" ]; then
            echo "Error: LIVEKIT_API_KEY_SIMULATION is not set in repository secrets"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_SIMULATION }}" ]; then
            echo "Error: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_SIMULATION is not set in repository secrets"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "${{ secrets.LIVEKIT_URL_SIMULATION }}" ]; then
            echo "Error: LIVEKIT_URL_SIMULATION is not set in repository secrets"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Test with pytest and generate coverage
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          LIVEKIT_API_KEY_SIMULATION: ${{ secrets.LIVEKIT_API_KEY_SIMULATION }}
          LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_SIMULATION: ${{ secrets.LIVEKIT_API_SECRET_SIMULATION }}
          LIVEKIT_URL_SIMULATION: ${{ secrets.LIVEKIT_URL_SIMULATION }}
        run: |
          make test-cov

      - name: Generate coverage summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Coverage Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          uv run python scripts/check_coverage.py >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true

      - name: Coverage Report
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: py-cov-action/python-coverage-comment-action@v3
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MINIMUM_GREEN: 85
          MINIMUM_ORANGE: 70
          ANNOTATE_MISSING_LINES: true
          ANNOTATION_TYPE: warning

      - name: Upload coverage HTML report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: htmlcov/
          retention-days: 7

name: Deploy to Render and Run Hamming Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production

    steps:
      # 1) Check out your repo
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2) Log in to GitHub container registry
      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # 3) Extract docker metadata for tagging
      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/purplefish-ai/agent

      # 4) Build and push Docker image
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

      # 5) Trigger Render deploy hook (outbound) and check for failure
      - name: Trigger Render deploy hook (outbound)
        run: |
          set -e  # Exit if any command fails
          curl --fail -s "${{ secrets.RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}"
          echo "Successfully triggered outbound deploy."

      # 6) Trigger Render deploy hook (inbound) and capture its deploy ID
      - name: Trigger Render deploy hook (inbound)
        id: inbound_trigger
        run: |
          set -e
          # Use `--fail` to exit on non-2xx/3xx HTTP statuses
          DEPLOY_RESPONSE=$(curl --fail -s "${{ secrets.RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL_INBOUND }}")
          echo "Inbound deploy response: $DEPLOY_RESPONSE"

          INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID=$(echo "$DEPLOY_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.deploy.id')
          if [ -z "$INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID" ] || [ "$INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Unable to retrieve inbound deploy ID from response!"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "inbound_deploy_id=$INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # 7) Wait for the inbound deployment to go live (with loop timeout + curl failure check)
      - name: Wait for inbound deployment
        id: wait_inbound
        run: |
          set -e

          INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID="${{ steps.inbound_trigger.outputs.inbound_deploy_id }}"
          if [ -z "$INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID" ]; then
            echo "No inbound deploy ID found!"
            exit 1
          fi

          MAX_ATTEMPTS=30  # e.g., 30 attempts
          ATTEMPT=0
          SLEEP_INTERVAL=10

          while [ $ATTEMPT -lt $MAX_ATTEMPTS ]; do
            ATTEMPT=$((ATTEMPT+1))
            echo "Checking inbound deploy status (attempt $ATTEMPT/$MAX_ATTEMPTS)..."

            RESPONSE=$(curl --fail -s \
              -H "accept: application/json" \
              -H "authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}" \
              "https://api.render.com/v1/services/${{ secrets.RENDER_SERVICE_ID_INBOUND }}/deploys/$INBOUND_DEPLOY_ID") || {
                echo "Curl request to Render API failed!"
                exit 1
              }

            STATUS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.status')
            echo "Inbound deployment status: $STATUS"

            if [ "$STATUS" = "live" ]; then
              echo "Inbound deployment is live!"
              break
            elif [ "$STATUS" = "failed" ]; then
              echo "Inbound deployment failed!"
              exit 1
            fi

            if [ $ATTEMPT -eq $MAX_ATTEMPTS ]; then
              echo "Timed out waiting for inbound deployment to become live."
              exit 1
            fi

            sleep $SLEEP_INTERVAL
